settings.directory.label: Save to
settings.directory.description: Folder the recordings are written to.
settings.filename_pattern.label: Filename pattern
settings.filename_pattern.description: Date-format pattern without the extension, e.g. snip_%Y%m%d_%H%M%S.
settings.frame_rate.label: Frame rate
settings.frame_rate.description: Capture frame rate. 30 is plenty for a chat clip and halves the file size.
settings.encoder.label: Encoder
settings.encoder.description: CPU always works. VAAPI offloads encoding to the GPU, which matters on large regions.
settings.quality.label: Quality
settings.quality.description: Constant quality, 0–51. Lower is better looking and larger.
settings.copy_to_clipboard.label: Copy to clipboard
settings.copy_to_clipboard.description: Put the finished file on the clipboard so it can be pasted into a chat with Ctrl+V.
settings.show_timer.label: Show timer
settings.show_timer.description: Show elapsed time next to the icon while recording (horizontal bars only).
settings.max_duration.label: Maximum duration
settings.max_duration.description: Stop automatically after this many seconds. 0 disables the limit.
settings.hide_inactive.label: Hide when idle
settings.hide_inactive.description: Hide the bar icon while nothing is being recorded.
settings.vaapi_device.label: VAAPI device
settings.vaapi_device.description: Render node used for GPU encoding.
notify.bad-selection: Could not read the selected region.
notify.selection-too-small: The selected region is too small.
